Naga film 'Angh' wins award at Toronto Film Festival

The Naga film 'Angh', directed by Theja Rio, has won a $20,000 CAD prize from The Platform jury at the Toronto Film Festival. The film, set near the Indo-Burma border in Nagaland, focuses on the last chief of a village facing significant community changes. The jury cited the film's "refreshing perspective" and "deeply resonant por".
